default.question: How to Install AskBot, AskBot Installation, Install AskBot
default.answer:
![Logo](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/SAP-Custom-Widget/AskBotAI/icon.png)

To get started with **AskBot**, first download the [AskBotAI.json](https://sap-custom-widget.rohitchouhan.com/?dl=AskBotAI) file.

**Key Features**:-
| Feature | Description | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **NLP Search** |Natural Language Processing AI | ✅ Supported |
| **Markdown** | Tables, Lists, **Bold**, and Links | ✅ Supported |
| **Voice Input** | Integrated Speech-to-Text (STT) | ✅ Supported |
| **Speech Output** | Natural Text-to-Speech (TTS) | ✅ Supported |
| **Interactive** | Buttons, Links, and Flow Triggers | ✅ Supported |

default.question: step_2
default.answer: Log in to your **SAC** tenet, navigate to **Stories** in the left panel, and click on **Custom Widget**.

default.question: step_3
default.answer:
Next, click the **+** icon ➕ to upload your downloaded **AskBotAI.json** file. 📁 

🎉 Congratulations, you are all set! 🚀

default.answer: AskBot is an AI-powered custom chat box designed for SAP Analytics Cloud. It is developed by Rohit Chouhan.

default.question: What is AskBot, Working of AskBot, How AskBot Works, What is the Working of AskBot, AskBot Functionality, AskBot Capabilities, What Does AskBot Do, AskBot AI Features
default.answer: AskBot helps you integrate a chatbot system into SAP Analytics Cloud. It is AI-powered and helps users get accurate responses by understanding the intent of the question, not just fixed keywords.
